title: C-3PO
description: Protocol Droid C-3PO was on the Tantive IV as the ship was fleeing Darth Vader. He and R2-D2 escaped to Tatooine. Taken by Jawas, the pair came into the possession of Luke Skywalker. The plans hidden on R2-D2 led the trio to Obi-Wan Kenobi and eventually, the Death Star. C-3PO was concerned over damage that R2-D2 took in the Battle of Yavin.
